reason: I have a drawer full of half-used supplement bottles and I don't take anything unless a doctor says so. The lab report is a good sign, but nobody has told me I'm low on magnesium, so I'd just be adding another bottle.
objection: A tested batch only proves what's in the capsule, not that I need it or that it does anything for me. $30 a month is real money on $28k a year.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me to take magnesium, or a price around $15 a month with the guarantee.
